notes: Two panels. MAIN (everything above/left of the heavy black line that runs along the bottom-left at x about 2780, then diagonally beside Spring Grove, then east at y about 5560-5580): Mitchell Av. down the left edge (printed 40 ft north of the C.H.&D. railroad, 50 ft south of it; west face x about 250-340, east face about 500-615), the C.H.&D. railroad and sidings crossing the top third, the Cincinnati Car Co. / Cincinnati Traction Co. works, and Spring Grove Av. (100 ft) running diagonally from the bottom-left corner to the right edge at about y 3000-3600. Ammen Av. (no width printed, about 60 ft drawn) runs south-east from Spring Grove into the panel line. The long thin diagonal line from about (4400,1600) to (3700,4700) and the curved lines are property/track lines, not streets. NORTH-EAST panel (below the heavy line, right part of the sheet, drawn rotated about 45 degrees: north arrow points up-left): the block west of Spring Grove and south-west of Fairview Av. (J.W. Biles Co. feed mill, A.O.U.W. hall). Fairview Av. (40 ft) runs across the panel to Spring Grove Av. (100 ft, vertical along the right edge, only its west face drawn). No other street meets on this panel; the vertical lines labelled SIDING are railroad sidings.
